next.reason: 1985: "In the File Section, the VALUE clause may be used only in condition-name entries; ... take effect only when the program is placed into its initial state"; 2023: "In the file section, VALUE clauses take effect only during the execution of an INITIALIZE statement.". 2023 allows VALUE on File/Linkage data items, effective via INITIALIZE. Working-storage VALUE also takes effect on INITIALIZE. The Communication Section is gone.
